issues.action: Do not merge names or populate verified aliases; request entity/range evidence.

issues.finding: August reporting does not establish current existence or operation in November.
issues.action: Current operation remains unable_to_verify; source read date is not last_verified_on.

issues.finding: Functional description and reported locality lack formal category or full address verification.
issues.action: Keep category provisional and verified_address/admin_village null; do not classify as a formal school/library.

issues.finding: Recovered screenshots lack complete layer provenance/CRS; hand-drawn map authorship/reuse permission is unresolved.
issues.action: Exclude source images from release; verify providers, author, date and de-identification first.
